text: In arguing that efficient models can reach the debate equilibrium, the authors note that debate with optimal play answers NEXP questions for polynomial-time judges only with computationally unbounded debaters (Irving et al., 2018). They call that assumption unrealistic and say a different, realistic efficiency notion is needed for the safety case.
title: Buhl et al. call the unbounded-debater assumption behind Irving et al.'s complexity results unrealistic
